context: Use one canonical project-relative wrapper-path helper for init-project, refresh-wrapper, doctor, and _wrapper_script. Reject absolute and escaping paths; collapse dot, duplicate separators, and in-root parent traversals before storing the config or calculating depth. Preserve custom nested paths. For redaction, parse the configured hosted URL and replace longest non-empty variants: exact configured URL, normalized URL, HTTPS equivalent for libsql, authority/netloc, hostname, and hostname with default port where applicable. Never include token or endpoint variants in output. Add focused regression tests for ./, repeated separators, nested/../ normalization, escape/absolute rejection, custom depth, and libsql-to-https/host:443 errors at connect and execute time.
description: Close the accepted findings from the Google Antigravity review of merged PRs 12-15. SEC-01 applies in refined form: pathlib already normalizes leading dot and redundant separators, but accepted in-root paths containing '..' can make _wrapper_script compute the wrong REPO_ROOT depth. Normalize and validate wrapper paths before recording or generating them. SEC-02 is required because the URL-redaction contract must cover protocol-translated libsql errors that report https:// or host:port variants rather than the configured libsql:// URL. Rebut OPS-01 because CLI help and README already document direct v2 negotiation.

anti_patterns.dont: Count raw Path.parts before canonicalizing parent traversal
anti_patterns.instead: canonicalize one project-relative path before recording and generation
anti_patterns.why: an in-root a/../ path generates too many upward segments

anti_patterns.dont: Redact only the exact configured URL string
anti_patterns.instead: derive and redact parsed protocol and authority variants longest-first
anti_patterns.why: libsql drivers can report an HTTPS authority or host:port representation

preserves.behavior: Default and custom nested generated wrappers resolve the repository root exactly and refresh-wrapper never writes outside it.
Hosted token and every configured or translated endpoint representation remain absent from exceptions and tracebacks.
V2 exit negotiation, credential precedence, one-shot wrapper behavior, and non-auth error classification remain unchanged.

prior_art.concept: v2 wrapper generation and targeted refresh

verifications.command: uv run pytest tests/test_bootstrap.py tests/test_hosted_backend.py -q -k 'wrapper or redacted or protocol or authority'

work_units.evidence: Canonical wrapper path helper collapses dot/redundant/in-root parent segments, rejects absolute/escape/symlink traversal, records normalized config, and drives generation/refresh/doctor
work_units.summary: Normalize and validate wrapper paths across scaffold, refresh, doctor, and generation

work_units.evidence: Hosted redaction derives exact, normalized, HTTPS-equivalent, authority, hostname, and host:port variants and replaces longest-first
work_units.summary: Redact protocol-translated URL, authority, and host-port variants

work_units.evidence: Regression coverage added for normalized depth, refresh of legacy unnormalized config, path escape/absolute/symlink rejection, and translated endpoint redaction at connect/execute
work_units.summary: Add focused regressions and run auth/bootstrap/full verification
